mix.label: The setting
mix.headline: How much of your work should the machine take over?
mix.hint: Grab the knob and turn it
mix.note: We set this dial with you, trade by trade. It never goes all the way: someone always keeps a hand on it.

z1.name: It all rests on you
z1.text: Every missed call, every quote, every post waits until you have a spare minute. Usually in the evening.

z2.name: A little help
z2.text: A couple of tools take some weight off. The rest still goes through your hands, and nothing moves while you are on site.

z3.name: Our setting
z3.text: You keep the decision, the tone and the relationship. The rest runs without you: replying within the minute, following up, posting, sorting.

z4.name: The machine decides
z4.text: Everything goes out on its own, including what should never have been sent. Your clients notice before you do.
